scripts.build: pnpm --filter @deskbeacon/protocol build && pnpm --filter deskbeacon build && pnpm --filter @deskbeacon/server build
scripts.check: pnpm --filter @deskbeacon/protocol check && pnpm --filter deskbeacon check && pnpm --filter @deskbeacon/server check
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @deskbeacon/protocol build && pnpm --filter @deskbeacon/protocol test && pnpm --filter deskbeacon build && node --test apps/client/test/foreground-pool.test.mjs && node apps/client/test/tui-terminal-guard.mjs && node apps/client/test/ansi-render-regression.mjs && pnpm --filter @deskbeacon/server test
scripts.test:pool: pnpm --filter @deskbeacon/protocol build && pnpm --filter deskbeacon build && node --test apps/client/test/foreground-pool.test.mjs
